classes.name: results
classes.reason: Each class_b file is written via probe.write_staged, whose os.fsync makes the rank wait for durability inside a generation loop bracketed by barrier.wait(), so all other ranks are held at the next barrier until that write completes.

classes.name: diagnostics
classes.reason: class_a files are written once each with probe.write_buffered, which opens, writes and closes with no fsync and no timing probe, so the data drains in the background while the rank proceeds to the next task and no other rank waits on it.
